feeds.title: Darkwave Metal
feeds.description: This website was built with the intention to give a detailed overview on my music to everyone who wish to dig deeper into the past, present and future of Darkwave. Darkwave is an experimental music project incorporating elements of instrumental thrash metal combined with symphonic and electronic influences.
